claim_class: established external experimental evidence plus project arithmetic benchmark
claim: High CT-dissociation efficiency is not sufficient for high collected photocurrent/IQE; transport/collection can remain the dominant penalty even when TDCF-derived dissociation is nearly unchanged.

source.citation: Wang et al., Rethinking Charge Transport and Recombination in Donor-Diluted Organic Solar Cells, Advanced Materials (2026)
source.dataset_license_note: Zenodo record is public and exposes figure CSV files; this repository stores only independently transcribed Table 1 summary values and provenance, not upstream data files.
source.article_values_location: Main-text Table 1, Section 2.3 Internal Quantum Efficiency
source.independence_note: Article states solar-cell parameters were extracted from 20 independently fabricated cells; Table 1 values are paper-level process-efficiency summaries and are not reinterpreted as 20 independent values.

symbols.eta_diss: CT-exciton dissociation efficiency at short circuit from TDCF fit, dimensionless
symbols.eta_col: competition between recombination and charge collection, dimensionless

predeclared_checks.domain: 0 < eta_exc, eta_diss, IQE <= 1; derived eta_col must be in (0,1] for these fixtures
predeclared_checks.limiting_case: If IQE = eta_exc * eta_diss then eta_col = 1
predeclared_checks.negative_control: Near-equal eta_diss alone must not be classified as sufficient evidence of near-equal collection or useful work.

uncertainty.reason: No formal uncertainty for these Table 1 summary values is supplied in the main-text table; none is invented.
uncertainty.reporting_resolution_sensitivity: For a non-statistical transcription sensitivity only, perturb each two-decimal efficiency by +/-0.005 within physical bounds.

validity_domain: PM6:Y12 donor-dilution system at the source conditions; this benchmark is a conventional-mechanism counterexample and is not a quantitative D18/PY-IT/eC9 threshold or prediction.
falsifier: This benchmark would be invalidated if the source Table 1 values or factorization were corrected, or if independent re-analysis of the source data showed that the quoted dissociation and IQE values are not comparable at short-circuit conditions.
decision_delta: For D18/PY-IT/eC9, passing a field-generation/TDCF gate cannot by itself support a useful-work claim. Transport/collection and stabilized FF/Pmax must remain co-primary discriminators.
